Definition: from G4994; discipline, i.e. self-control:--sound mind.
BiblicalUsage: God hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind. The sound mind here is the disciplined mind fear cannot rule.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fear is not from God, and the sound mind He gives is what lets love and power do their work.
